adapter.detect.lookpath_failed: Looking for its program on PATH failed.
adapter.detect.unreadable: A file or directory it needs is there but cannot be read.
completion.long:
Load it in the current shell:

  bash:        source <({{cli}} completion bash)
  zsh:         source <({{cli}} completion zsh)
  fish:        {{cli}} completion fish | source
  PowerShell:  {{cli}} completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression

To load it in every new shell, add that line to your shell's startup file.
completion.short: Print the completion script for bash, zsh, fish or powershell
config.bad_value: "{{value}}" is not a valid value for {{key}}: {{reason}}
config.flag_only: "{{key}}" is not a setting: it can only be given on the command line, as {{flag}}, each time.
config.get.short: Show the value of one setting
config.list.short: Show every setting, its value and where the value comes from
config.not_in_file: "{{key}}" cannot be kept in the configuration file. Use {{ways}}.
config.reason.lang: use a language tag such as en or zh-CN
config.reason.url: use an address that starts with https:// or http://
config.set.long:
A list takes its items separated by commas, such as: {{cli}} config set tools.disabled opencode,codex
An empty value removes the setting from the file, and the default applies again.
config.set.overridden: {{origin}} is set right now and takes precedence over the file for {{key}}.
config.set.short: Change a setting in the local configuration file
config.short: Show and change the local configuration
config.unknown_key: Unknown setting "{{key}}". Run "{{cli}} config list" to see every setting.
config.warn.flag_only: Ignoring {{key}} in {{origin}}: it only counts when given on the command line as {{flag}}.
config.warn.not_in_file: Ignoring "{{key}}" in {{origin}}: it cannot be kept in the configuration file.
config.warn.unknown_key: Ignoring "{{key}}" in {{origin}}: this version does not know it.
doctor.config.env_invalid: The environment variable {{name}} has the value "{{value}}", which is not valid.
doctor.config.ignored_hint: Run "{{cli}} config list" to see the settings in effect.
doctor.config.missing: There is no {{path}}; the defaults apply.
doctor.config.title: Local configuration
doctor.config.unreadable_hint: Nothing overwrites it. Fix the file or move it away; until then, the commands that need the configuration stop.
doctor.git.broken_hint: Check that {{path}} is a working Git, or set {{env}} to another one.
doctor.git.missing: No git program was found on PATH.
doctor.git.missing_hint: Syncing straight from a resource repository needs Git. Install it, or set {{env}} to the path of the git program.
doctor.git.not_found: The git program {{path}} does not exist or cannot be run.
doctor.git.title: Git
doctor.home.missing: {{path}} does not exist yet. The first sync creates it.
doctor.home.not_dir_hint: Move it somewhere else: {{cli}} keeps its records in a directory of that name.
doctor.home.ok: {{path}} exists and only you can open it.
doctor.home.title: Local data directory
doctor.home.unknown: Cannot tell where the local data directory is: {{detail}}
doctor.home.unknown_hint: Set {{env}} to an absolute path, or use --home.
doctor.intents.busy: Another {{cli}} is changing things right now, so this cannot be checked.
doctor.intents.busy_hint: Run the check again when it has finished.
doctor.intents.none: None: every write was finished and recorded.
doctor.intents.pending_hint: The next sync finishes or drops each one whose target it can recognise; the rest stay listed here. Look at these paths before changing them by hand.
doctor.intents.pending_one: {{count}} write was started and not recorded in the manifest.
doctor.intents.pending_other: {{count}} writes were started and not recorded in the manifest.
doctor.intents.title: Unfinished writes
doctor.intents.unreadable: The intent log {{path}} cannot be read: {{detail}}
doctor.intents.unreadable_hint: Until this is fixed, sync and uninstall change nothing. Do not delete the file: it lists writes that may be half done.
doctor.leftovers.found_hint: Nothing uses them. Delete them while no {{cli}} is running.
doctor.leftovers.found_one: {{count}} temporary file or directory was left behind by a run that did not finish.
doctor.leftovers.found_other: {{count}} temporary files or directories were left behind by runs that did not finish.
doctor.leftovers.title: Temporary files
doctor.manifest.invalid: {{path}} does not hold what a manifest should: {{detail}}
doctor.manifest.missing: Nothing has been written yet ({{path}} does not exist).
doctor.manifest.newer: {{path}} was written by a newer version of {{cli}}.
doctor.manifest.newer_hint: Use that newer version, or a later one. This one changes nothing until then.
doctor.manifest.previous_hint: Until this is fixed, sync and uninstall change nothing. Do not delete the file: it is the only record of what was written. The manifest as it was before the last write is {{previous}}.
doctor.manifest.title: Manifest
doctor.manifest.unknown_hint: Until this is fixed, sync and uninstall change nothing. Do not delete the file: it is the only record of what was written.
doctor.skipped_no_home: Not checked: where the local data directory is is not known.
doctor.tool_roots.none: No installed tool to look at.
doctor.tool_roots.ok: The directories of {{tool}} can be written to.
doctor.tool_roots.outside: {{path}} is a symbolic link to {{target}}, outside your home directory.
doctor.tool_roots.outside_hint: {{cli}} only writes inside your home directory, so writing to {{tool}} will fail. Replace the link with the directory itself, or point {{tool}} at {{target}} directly.
doctor.tool_roots.title: Tool directories
doctor.tools.disabled: {{tool}} is switched off in the local configuration ({{key}}).
doctor.tools.installed_no_version: {{tool}} is installed; its version could not be read.
doctor.tools.newer: {{tool}} {{version}} is newer than {{verified}}, the version its support was checked against.
doctor.tools.newer_hint: Syncing still works. If something ends up in the wrong place, please report it.
doctor.tools.none: This build of {{cli}} supports no AI tool.
doctor.tools.title: AI tools
doctor.tools.unknown_hint: {{cli}} leaves {{tool}} alone until this can be read.
doctor.tools.unverified: {{tool}} is installed, but its support has not been checked against the real tool yet, so {{cli}} writes nothing to it.
error.bad_lang: "{{value}}" is not a language tag. Use one such as en or zh-CN.
error.config_unreadable: Cannot use the local configuration {{path}}: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed; fix or remove the file and try again.
error.env_invalid: The environment variable {{name}} has the value "{{value}}", which is not valid: {{reason}}.
error.internal: Internal error: {{detail}}. Please report it with the output of "{{cli}} version".
error.no_home: Cannot tell where your home directory is. Set {{env}} or use --home.
error.started_from_explorer: This is a command-line program. Open a terminal (PowerShell or Command Prompt) and run {{cli}} there.
error.usage_hint: Run "{{command}} --help" to see how to use it.
flag.json: Print one machine-readable JSON document on standard output
flag.lang: Interface language, such as en or zh-CN
flag.non_interactive: Never ask; treat every question as answered "no"
flag.quiet: Say less: only warnings and errors
help.more: Run "{{command}} <command> --help" for more about a command.
root.short: Sync your team's AI coding resources into the AI tools on this computer, and undo it cleanly
version.short: Show the version, commit, build time and platform
